details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1342-1368 (also scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:472-477, scripts/review_autofix_step_partial_finalize.sh:372-385) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On a same-head partial resume the ledger stage is skipped and partial_finalize's runtime_artifacts list does not include review_unreachable_all.tsv, review_unreachable_new.tsv or review_unreachable_summary.md, so these files are missing from the resumed RUNTIME_DIR, while the restored ledger and review_issues.txt still hold the unreachable entries.
  WHY: All three consumers fail open. The editor scope note disappears, so the editor edits unreachable paths such as `.github/workflows/**` and the sandbox transfer discards every edit. The `unreachable_security_hold` clean-marker check is skipped, so the head can be marked clean while a security finding is open. The "Unreachable findings" PR-comment section is dropped. Severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 rated BLOCKER; the other four rated MAJOR.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:472-477 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `unreachable_security_hold` branch only sets a local `clean_marker_reason` and logs it. It writes nothing to GITHUB_ENV or GITHUB_OUTPUT, so the auto-merge gates at `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4741`/`4784` and the judge routing at line 4865 never see the hold.
  WHY: On a normal round with an open unreachable security finding, `steps.single_issue_security_pass.outputs.hold != 'true'` is satisfied and `gh pr merge --auto` is allowed without the judge ever seeing the finding. This breaks "security finding on an unreachable file still blocks the merge".
- scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh:prior-entry loop (`if [ "${prior_status}" = "FIXED" ] || ... "unreachable" ]; then status="${prior_status}"`, `FINAL_U_SECURITY[...]`, `unreachable_all_rows+=`; no line numbers stated) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: Once a finding is recorded as unreachable with `UNREACHABLE_SECURITY: true`, nothing clears it. Absent entries keep `status=unreachable`/`security=true` and are re-written to review_unreachable_all.tsv every round, and only `CI_EXEMPT_BLOCK` (current-round findings only) exits the sticky status.
  WHY: After a human fixes the file, every later round still finds a security row. The `review-autofix-clean:v1` marker is never written again, every same-head re-trigger runs a full round, and the judge keeps getting `security_hold=true`, with no code path that clears it.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "A security finding on an unreachable file still blocks the merge; it goes to the follow-up issue and also keeps the PR blocked for the judge." (Linked issue #10057, Constraints §1)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml `Enable auto-merge on PR` condition at line 4741, ready-to-merge condition at line 4784, and review-blocked judge routing at line 4865 (and 5838); plus a GITHUB_OUTPUT export (for example `unreachable_security_hold`) from scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The auto-merge `if:` at line 4741 gates only on `steps.commit_changes.outputs.did_commit` and `steps.single_issue_security_pass.outputs.hold`, and `single_issue_security_pass` is off by default (line 4705). The ready-to-merge condition at line 4784 is unchanged. The judge condition at line 4865 (4860-4865) fires only at max_iterations or security-pass exhaustion. scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh writes no `>> "$GITHUB_ENV"`/`>> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"` of the hold; there is only a local `clean_marker_reason` log line at line 492. The `unreachable_security_hold` branch only suppresses the clean marker, which governs same-head re-review skips (scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh around line 883). scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh never reads the clean marker (gates at review_enable_auto_merge.sh:130-348; merge at :469). The PR changes review_autofix.yml only to add the env var at line 2106. `test_security_hold_blocks_clean_marker` asserts only the source-text position of the branch.
- requirement: "Remove non-security unreachable findings from the editor's input and from the round's open-issue count" (Linked issue #10057, Approach §3)
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh editor prompt input assembly (reviewer_bundle.txt / floor_tags.txt embeds around lines 1714-1737), or ledger-side bundle filtering in scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The full `${RUNTIME_DIR}/reviewer_bundle.txt` is still embedded as "the authoritative findings source" (review_apply_fixes.sh:1735-1737, :1764), and floor_tags.txt is unfiltered (lines 1714-1716, 1766). Only review_issues.txt (which the prompt calls "advisory only") is stubbed, via `rewrite_review_issues_without_residuals` (lines 1457-1475) and `emit_unreachable_stub`. `_review_unreachable_editor_scope_note` (lines 1342-1355) only appends a textual exception, lists at most 50 paths (line 1349), and is lost on partial resume.
- requirement: `RUNTIME_DIR/review_unreachable_all.tsv`, `review_unreachable_new.tsv` and `review_unreachable_summary.md` must survive a same-head partial resume, or every consumer must rebuild them from durable ledger state (Linked issue #10057, §18 and the partial-resume guarantee)
  expected_change_site: the `runtime_artifacts` tuple in scripts/review_autofix_step_partial_finalize.sh:374-383, or a rebuild from `${REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH}` in the resume branch of scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1357-1368, with a `grep -q '^UNREACHABLE_SECURITY: true$'` fallback in post_editor_summary.sh:472-477
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The runtime_artifacts list at scripts/review_autofix_step_partial_finalize.sh:374-383 omits all three files. The resume branch at scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1357-1368 only reuses `LEDGER_STATUS_FILE`. scripts/review_autofix_step_restore_partial_resume.sh:89-101 copies whatever is in `source_dir`, so the gap is upstream. The in-PR hardening (rebuild from ledger, grep fallback) is absent.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh:prior-entry loop `if [ "${prior_status}" = "FIXED" ] || [ "${prior_status}" = "accepted-residual" ] || [ "${prior_status}" = "unreachable" ]; then status="${prior_status}"`, `FINAL_U_SECURITY["${issue_id}"]="${PRIOR_U_SECURITY["${issue_id}"]:-false}"`, `unreachable_all_rows+=`; also scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh `elif ... awk -F '\t' '$5 == "true" ...' review_unreachable_all.tsv` → `clean_marker_reason="unreachable_security_hold"` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A finding recorded as unreachable with `UNREACHABLE_SECURITY: true` is never cleared. Absent entries keep status=unreachable/security=true and are re-written to the TSV every round, and only `CI_EXEMPT_BLOCK` (current-round findings only) exits the status.
  WHY: After a human fix, the clean marker is never written again, every same-head re-trigger runs a full round, and the judge keeps getting `security_hold=true` from `render_review_rb_prior_round_decisions_file`. No code path clears it, despite the changelog's "until a judge or a human clears it".
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:lines 1358-1359 (resume branch); related scripts/review_autofix_step_partial_finalize.sh lines 374-384 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: review_unreachable_all.tsv/new.tsv are written only by review_issue_ledger.sh. A same-head resume skips the ledger stage and partial_finalize does not snapshot them, so they are missing, while the ledger and review_issues.txt still hold unreachable entries.
  WHY: The editor prompt loses the "Exception to the rule above" list and edits unreachable paths, so the sandbox discards every edit. The `$5 == "true"` check finds no file, so the clean marker can be written. The "Unreachable findings" PR-comment section is missing. Suggested fix: rebuild the TSV from `STATUS: unreachable` ledger entries at line 1359, or a `grep -q '^UNREACHABLE_SECURITY: true$' "${REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH}"` fallback.
- TASK_GAP | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  Requirement: "a security finding on an unreachable file still blocks the merge; it goes to the follow-up issue and also keeps the PR blocked for the judge."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml `Enable auto-merge on PR` step condition at line 4741, or a step output from scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh that the merge steps read.
  Evidence of absence: The `if:` at line 4741 gates only on `did_commit` and `single_issue_security_pass.outputs.hold`, and `single_issue_security_pass` defaults to off (line 4705). A round with only a held finding makes no commit, so auto-merge is enabled. The hold only suppresses the clean marker (scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh around line 883). review_autofix.yml is changed only to add the env var at line 2106.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  Requirement: "Remove non-security unreachable findings from the editor's input."
  Expected change site: scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh, where the editor prompt embeds reviewer_bundle.txt and floor_tags.txt.
  Evidence of absence: Only review_issues.txt ("advisory only") is stubbed. reviewer_bundle.txt ("authoritative") and floor_tags.txt are embedded unfiltered. `_review_unreachable_editor_scope_note` is only a prompt note, and it is lost on partial resume.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items): scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh `unreachable_security_hold` elif should also take the branch on `grep -q '^UNREACHABLE_SECURITY: true$' "${REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH:-}"` (2 lines). scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh resume branch at line 1359 should rebuild the 7-column review_unreachable_all.tsv from the ledger's `STATUS: unreachable` entries (10 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:lines 472-477 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The unreachable security hold logic depends on RUNTIME_DIR/review_unreachable_all.tsv, which is not regenerated on partial resume.
  WHY: On a same-head partial resume the ledger stage is reused, so the hold check is skipped and the PR head can be wrongly marked clean while an unreachable security finding is open.
- TASK_GAP | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  Requirement: "A security finding on an unreachable file still blocks the merge; it goes to the follow-up issue and also keeps the PR blocked for the judge."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml auto-merge gate and review-blocked judge routing.
  Evidence of absence: The auto-merge condition at line 4741 checks steps.single_issue_security_pass.outputs.hold but has no unreachable-security hold check. The review-blocked judge does not re-check it for non-exhausted rounds.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Requirement: "Remove non-security unreachable findings from the editor's input."
  Expected change site: scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh editor prompt input assembly.
  Evidence of absence: The scope note (lines 1358-1359) only tells the editor to ignore the paths. No filtering removes the findings from reviewer_bundle.txt or floor_tags.txt.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-f
